title: Right derived functors of a finite product are the product of right derived functors
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and, for each $i\in I$, let $\mathcal A_i$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and let $\Gamma_i: \mathcal A_i\to\mathbf{Ab}$ be an additive left exact functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. On the product category $\prod_{i\in I}\mathcal A_i$, the componentwise product functor $\Gamma((A_i)_i)=\prod_{i\in I}\Gamma_i(A_i)$ is additive and left exact, and its right derived functors satisfy $R^q\Gamma((A_i)_i)\cong\prod_{i\in I}R^q\Gamma_i(A_i)$ naturally for every $q\ge0$.
